name: Animal Riff
memo: Pearl Jam - Animal: driving riff. 90s rock crunch (Les Paul/Tele into cranked Marshall-style amp), mids forward, tight room.

band.style_feel: driving straight eighths, punchy kick and snare, tight and aggressive
parts: Part A: intro riff - guitar riff, drums enter
Part B: verse - D-based, tighter and sparser
Part C: chorus - full band, A-C-D-G
Part D: solo/interlude - same drive as the chorus
Part E: outro - final chorus and ending
band.tips: Tempo and key vary by source (about 106 BPM, A). Check by ear. Play the intro riff cleanly for 2 bars before the Trio+ learns, and keep strumming steady.

whammy.tuning: Standard (E A D G B E) - unverified
how: Tune your guitar to standard (E A D G B E).
Leave the Whammy DT off or bypassed.
whammy.tips: Could not verify the recording's tuning: tab sites list standard tuning, but no gear source confirms it, and none mention any whammy/octave/harmony effect. Play it in standard and check by ear; if it sounds lower, try TRANSPOSE DOWN 1-2 with DROPTUNE.

guitar.position: bridge pickup for the riff, tone knob around 8; bridge for the solo
guitar.tone_notes: Only the solo guitar (Gibson 335, per McCready) is documented; rhythm guitar gear on the recording is unconfirmed. Humbuckers fit the thick, mid-forward crunch; with single-coils add gain and roll back treble.

name: Animal Lead
memo: Animal: solo/lead sections. Lead amp, more drive, delay for sustain.
